definitions.gloss: sudden memory lapse; momentary forgetting; mental blank
definitions.explanation: The experience of suddenly being unable to recall something you normally know well. A temporary lapse rather than genuine forgetting.

examples.japanese: ⟦{名前|なまえ}→名前：02234_namae⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{度忘|どわす}れ⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧しまった。
examples.english: I had a sudden lapse and forgot the name.

examples.japanese: ⟦パスワード→パスワード：05277_pasuwaado⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{度忘|どわす}れ⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧、⟦ログインできない→ログインする：23297_roguinsuru⟧。
examples.english: I've blanked on my password and can't log in.
Memory lapses increase with age, but it happens to everyone.

notes:
Describes a temporary memory blank — you know something well but momentarily cannot recall it. Not the same as genuinely forgetting.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {度忘|どわす}れ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to have a sudden memory lapse
- {度忘|どわす}れ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ふ}える→増える：01183_fueru⟧: memory lapses increase
- ⟦うっかり→うっかり：01863_ukkari⟧{度忘|どわす}れ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to absentmindedly blank
- ⟦{名前|なまえ}→名前：02234_namae⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{度忘|どわす}れ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to blank on a name

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{忘|わす}れる→忘れる：00474_wasureru⟧: to forget (general, may be permanent)
- {度忘|どわす}れ: momentary lapse (temporary, you know it really)
- ⟦{物忘|ものわす}れ→物忘れ：17610_monowasure⟧: forgetfulness (tendency to forget things)
- ⟦ど{忘|わす}れ→ど忘れ：17611_dowasure⟧: same word written with hiragana ど

USAGE:
Often used with a sense of embarrassment or self-deprecation. The experience is relatable and common, so it's not considered a serious concern unless it happens very frequently.
